About A2C

A2C is run by a group of entrepreneurs who have been running multi-destination tourism service companies for more than 14 years. We first built our own operations system, adapting modern technology to our real needs. Once we saw what a game changer it was, and how liberating it is to focus on growing the business instead of just running it, we took the next step into agentic communication.

We know the pain of answering customers on time because we live it every day. We come from tourism, and today we offer the same technology to any business that serves customers on WhatsApp and by phone.
